scripts.dev: npm run sync:assets && npx wrangler@4.123.0 dev
scripts.deploy: npm run sync:assets && npm test && npx wrangler@4.123.0 deploy --minify
scripts.build:pages: npm run sync:assets && npx wrangler@4.123.0 deploy --dry-run --outdir .pages-bundle && node scripts/prepare-pages.mjs
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build:pages && npx wrangler@4.123.0 pages dev --cwd pages --port 8787
scripts.pages:deploy: npm test && npm run build:pages && npx wrangler@4.123.0 pages deploy --cwd pages
